classification.difficultyReason: Identify the remaining fraction of a whole after combining two fractions with related denominators.

content.prompt: In an apartment block, $\frac{7}{8}$ of the people speak English as their native language and $\frac{1}{16}$ speak Chinese as their native language. What fraction speak a language other than English or Chinese as their native language?

answer.worked:
Subtract the fractions speaking English or Chinese from the whole.

$$\begin{align*}1-\left(\frac{7}{8}+\frac{1}{16}\right)&=1-\left(\frac{14}{16}+\frac{1}{16}\right)\\1-\left(\frac{7}{8}+\frac{1}{16}\right)&=\frac{16}{16}-\frac{15}{16}\\1-\left(\frac{7}{8}+\frac{1}{16}\right)&=\frac{1}{16}.\end{align*}$$

$\frac{1}{16}$ of the people speak a native language other than English or Chinese.
